# Mohammed Maher – Creative Visual Designer Portfolio

## Site
- URL: https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/
- Languages: English (default), Arabic (RTL)
- Theme: Dark studio / Light mode toggle

## About
Mohammed Maher is a creative visual designer specialising in brand identity, digital design, print design, and motion graphics. The portfolio showcases selected client work, case studies, and design philosophy.

## Content Structure
- **Homepage** (`/`): Hero, Selected Work (3 featured projects), About, Skills & Expertise, Creative Journey, Contact
- **All Projects** (`/projects`): Full filterable project gallery
- **Project Detail** (`/:locale/projects/:slug`): Per-project case-study page
- **Admin** (`/admin`): Content management dashboard (not public)

## Key Sections
- **Selected Work**: Curated subset of published brand identity and design projects
- **Skills & Expertise**: Software proficiency (Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.) and design principles
- **Creative Journey**: Career milestones and growth timeline
- **Contact**: Email contact form

## Technical
- Frontend: React 19 + Vite 6, server-side rendered via Vercel
- Backend API: Laravel (PHP) on Render
- Images: Cloudinary CDN

## Contact
For inquiries, use the contact form at https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/#contact
